description: Implementation of the WifiManagerWPS class handling Wi-Fi Protected Setup (WPS) functionalities for a device, including initiating WPS pairing, managing SSID cache, and interacting with underlying bus calls.

classes.name: WifiManagerWPS
classes.description: A class managing WPS operations such as pairing, SSID storage, and status checks within a Wi-Fi management context.

methods.name: updateWifiWPSCache
methods.description: Sets whether to use cached paired SSID info.

methods.name: initiateWPSPairing
methods.description: Starts WPS pairing process with default parameters.

methods.name: initiateWPSPairing2
methods.description: Starts WPS pairing with specified method ('PBC', 'PIN', 'SERIALIZED_PIN') and relevant parameters.

methods.name: saveSSID
methods.description: Stores an SSID and passphrase with a specified security mode.

methods.name: getPairedSSID
methods.description: Retrieves the currently paired SSID, using cache if enabled.

methods.name: getPairedSSIDInfo
methods.description: Retrieves the paired SSID and BSSID information, using cache if enabled.

methods.name: isPaired
methods.description: Checks if the device is paired, based on the presence of SSID info.
